_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::membrane#2, and a FALSIFICATION of it. The entry told the reader to 'enable wrinkling model in material definition (e.g. MAT_MembraneWrinkling)'. That material does not exist on this build: substituting it into the upstream membrane_cyl_new_struc deck is rejected with 'Could not match this input' and the MAT_MembraneWrinkling line echoed, zero steps run. The membrane material catalogue is MAT_Membrane_ElastHyper and MAT_Membrane_ActiveStrain only; neither relaxes compressive stress, so there is no tension-field model to switch on and a compressive membrane state has to be detected by the user. The third arm pins the mistake an agent actually makes: swapping the membrane wrapper for the ordinary MAT_ElastHyper parses fine and is then refused by the element with 'The material does not support the evaluation of membranes'. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The material does not support the evaluation of membranes

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the real membrane material in the second arm. The unknown-material parse error vanishes and EXIT_WRINKLING becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the second pathology: keep the membrane-specific wrapper in the third arm. The element's refusal message vanishes and EXIT_PLAIN_HYPER becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
